units.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1. A targeted education agreement involving an obligation subsequently to perform municipal service (hereinafter, a targeted education agreement) is concluded between a local self-government body and a competitively selected citizen studying at a state higher education institution or a vocational educational institution with state accreditation for the relevant educational programme (hereinafter, the educational institution). It provides for the citizen’s obligation to perform municipal service in that local self-government body for a specified period after completing their studies.
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. A targeted education agreement involving an obligation…”

units.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. Citizens who have command of the state language of the Russian Federation, are obtaining vocational or higher education at the relevant level for the first time, and have no obligations under an apprenticeship or other agreement entailing employment relations after graduation are entitled to participate in the competition for a targeted education agreement (hereinafter, the competition).
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. Citizens who have command of the state language of the…”

units.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. A citizen participating in the competition must, when entering municipal service and throughout the mandatory period of municipal service following targeted education established by the agreement, meet the requirements for the relevant municipal service positions established by Federal Law No. 25-FZ of 2 March 2007 “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation” and Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 “On Municipal Service in the City of Moscow”.
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. A citizen participating in the competition must, when…”

units.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4. The representative body of local self-government decides to hold the competition. The competition is conducted by a competition commission whose formation and working procedure are established by that representative body.
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4. The representative body of local self-government decides to…”

units.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 5. Information about the competition must be published in the print medium used for official publication of municipal legal acts and posted on the local self-government body’s official website on the Internet information and telecommunications network at least one month before the competition date. It must include:
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “5. Information about the competition must be published in the…”

units.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1) the municipal service positions to be filled by citizens after graduation;
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1) the municipal service positions to be filled by citizens…”

units.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2) qualification requirements for municipal service positions (requirements concerning the level of vocational or higher education, field of study, knowledge and skills needed to perform official duties and, where the employer’s representative (employer) has made the relevant decision, speciality and field of study);
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2) qualification requirements for municipal service positions…”

units.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3) the list of documents to be submitted for the competition under Point 6 of these Regulations;
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3) the list of documents to be submitted for the competition…”
